verdict.rationale: SerpApi's integrations docs describe an MCP integration that lets any MCP-compatible agent (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.) use SerpApi as a web search tool. A probe confirms an official MCP server repository at github.com/serpapi/serpapi-mcp. Missing for 10: detailed setup and auth documentation, a list of exposed tools or engines, independent hands-on corroboration.
